Identity roles and scoped authorization
milestones.implementationNotes: Guest web/native identities and private recovery keys are implemented. The independent SwiftUI rehearsal client uses origin-scoped Keychain credentials. Multi-artist provisioning, staff roles, display pairing and stronger artist authentication remain open.

milestones.title: Artist album and event preparation
milestones.implementationNotes: Revision-fenced settings and private unplayed-track edits are joined by merged, validated real MP3/WAV ingestion, private content-addressed storage and authenticated stable delivery. Originals are not retained; a 192 kbps MP3 derivative is created. Real Neon delivery and artist-file/hardware acceptance remain open. PR25 adds an independently persistent local store and empty-start rehearsal.

milestones.title: Local album playback and show audio foundation
milestones.implementationNotes: Prepared device files persist in IndexedDB with SHA-256 verification; local album-order continuation releases live control and keeps generation paused. PR25 adds a separate real loopback server with persistent database/audio and no seeded events. This does not qualify hosted offline reload, physical output routing or venue use.

Durable realtime subscriptions and recovery
milestones.implementationNotes: Existing event-log streaming and snapshot fallback reject older responses and disable voting while offline, stale or awaiting foreground refresh. Per-process snapshot bounds, identity isolation, shared-network budgets and slow-socket disconnection are implemented. Multi-instance fanout and deployed venue/load acceptance remain open.

milestones.implementationNotes: Closed-round prompt snapshots and per-round provider choice feed Stable Audio 2.5 or Mureka instrumental generation. Selection is frozen; no cross-provider substitution or prompt truncation occurs. Mureka has a 1,024-character prompt limit and variable output length. Real provider acceptance remains unverified under the current $0 allowance.

milestones.title: Production V1 — approved work package 15 of 42
milestones.implementationNotes: Durable dispatch now persists asynchronous Mureka task IDs, distinguishes credit rejection from uncertainty, and rejects $0 or exhausted budgets before paid requests. No automatic replay of uncertain music POSTs occurs. Operator reconciliation UI and real billing/latency validation remain open.

milestones.title: Validated releases and artist review
milestones.implementationNotes: Boundary, immediate and artist-review policies are frozen per round. Private previews, explicit publication, holds and unsent cancellation preserve ownership and moderation. Both provider adapters validate decoded audio; real provider/storage delivery, exports and production rollout remain open.

milestones.title: Production V1 — approved work package 17 of 42
Production V1 — approved work package 18 of 42
Release email push and preferences
milestones.implementationNotes: Opt-in verified event email, encrypted contacts, bounded durable outbox, unsubscribe, signed suppression callbacks and foreground web release notices are implemented behind disabled delivery configuration. Real sender delivery, web/native push, large-crowd throughput and production migration remain open.

milestones.title: Performer feedback dashboard and Play next
milestones.implementationNotes: One-click queue ordering preserves current playback and rejects stale state. A simple Mureka/Stable Audio selector and real generation-failure activity panel are merged. Physical private-cue rehearsal remains open.

milestones.title: Private headphone cue and audio diagnostics
milestones.implementationNotes: Capability-detected output selection, distinct-output tone/confirmation gates, selected-sink playback and output-loss recovery are implemented. Default remains a separate headphone device; physical isolation, recording exclusion and native output acceptance remain open.

milestones.title: Recording capture and recovery
milestones.implementationNotes: Chunked checksummed local recording selects an exact browser input and stops on input disconnection. Synthetic browser coverage does not verify physical Rave/USB routing, long sessions or multitrack capture.

milestones.title: Production V1 — approved work package 23 of 42
Artist archives and remote audience access
milestones.implementationNotes: Public profiles, archives and likes are joined by remote voting policy, room codes, listener-only access and transactional contributor caps. PR25 implements native SwiftUI room-code admission; exact native acceptance, Expo parity, physical devices and venue-load qualification remain open.

milestones.title: Production V1 — approved work package 25 of 42
Load monitoring recovery and full show rehearsal
milestones.implementationNotes: The user confirmed Phillip's workspace and previously authorized the scoped migration set. Render now lists capacity, but this session's service creation was safety-blocked; no service exists and the denied operation must not be rerouted. A private Neon our-jam-media bucket was created on the isolated free rehearsal branch. PR25 provides an explicit real single-Mac runtime; exact local/native tests, live S3/hosted deployment and venue evidence remain required.

milestones.title: Production V1 — approved work package 27 of 42
Visual quality and performance refinement
milestones.implementationNotes: 3D Sound Waves separate readable layout from the lazy renderer, remember motion preferences, stop hidden/offscreen loops and recover context loss with a 2D field. Hardware frame/thermal targets, advanced packing and cinematic refinement remain open.

milestones.title: Production V1 — approved work package 29 of 42
Production V1 — approved work package 30 of 42
Fan collections following and return journeys
milestones.implementationNotes: Recoverable guest profiles, revocable private keys, artist following and private public-release feeds are implemented on web/API. Verified accounts, native recovery/follow UI and richer engagement remain open.

milestones.title: Native iOS and Android foundation
milestones.implementationNotes: Expo draft #11 remains audit-blocked; no audit bypass was applied. PR25 adds an independent genuine SwiftUI iOS client using system frameworks, real guest APIs and a simulator artifact pipeline. Simulator Release compilation succeeded; interaction/artifact acceptance must be confirmed from exact-head CI. Apple membership/signing, TestFlight, physical devices, full native feature parity and Android remain open.
